title: Base Read Input Registers variant 5
purpose: Use a two-request read sequence with changed unit and address context before exercising function code 0x04 for input registers; include a coherent exception-shaped response frame for response diversity.

messages.label: Preliminary Read Discrete Inputs request, unit 0x02, start 0x0000, quantity 8
Read Input Registers request, unit 0x04, start 0x0010, quantity 4
Read Input Registers exception response, unit 0x04, exception 0x84

expected_behavior: The server may process the preliminary discrete-input read and then return eight data bytes for four input registers, or return normal protocol/device exceptions when the unit or address range is unavailable.
constraints_preserved: Both messages use consistent Modbus/TCP MBAP framing.
Protocol identifier is 0x0000 in both headers.
Each length field is 0x0006 and matches the request body.
Transaction identifiers are ordered and distinct.
Function code 0x04 uses register address and quantity fields in canonical order.
Quantity 4 corresponds to eight response data bytes.
issue_safety_notes: External issue knowledge is unavailable; this stateful sequence expresses only conservative model-prior protocol plausibility and does not claim externally verified validity or security relevance.
